title: Russia Appoints D.Y. Chandrachud in Ukraine Arbitration

blocks.content: Russia has appointed former Chief Justice of India D.Y. Chandrachud as its arbitrator in an investment treaty arbitration filed by Ukraine’s state-owned Oschadbank. The dispute concerns assets and operations that Oschadbank says it lost in the Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson, and Zaporizhzhia regions after Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

items: Oschadbank is a state-owned bank of Ukraine.
The 1998 Agreement between Russia and Ukraine is an investment protection treaty.
Arbitral tribunals in treaty disputes commonly have three members.
Crimea was annexed by Russia in 2014, and a previous Oschadbank case over lost assets led to a damages award of about US$1.1 billion.
